name: io.forthroute/returns
title: ForthRoute Returns
description: Search, review, approve and decline Shopify returns in ForthRoute (OAuth, merchant account).

tools.name: search_returns
tools.description: Find returns in this store, newest activity first. Filter by order number, RMA, customer name or email, and/or status. Excludes onboarding test returns unless include_test is true.

query.description: Order number (e.g. #1001), RMA, customer name or email.

status.description: Only these statuses. REQUESTED = awaiting review.

tools.name: get_return
tools.description: Full details of one return: items, customer, order, shipping/tracking, timestamps and status history.

tools.name: get_returns_overview
tools.description: Counts of returns by status, how many await review and since when, and returns created in the last 30 days.

tools.name: approve_return
tools.description: Approve one REQUESTED return in Shopify, the same as clicking Approve in ForthRoute. The customer is emailed, and a prepaid label may be purchased according to the store's label settings. Does not issue the refund.

tools.name: decline_return
tools.description: Decline one REQUESTED return in Shopify, the same as clicking Decline in ForthRoute. The customer is emailed.

message_to_customer.description: Optional note included in the decline email.
